technique_name: Describe the process for creating a PowerPoint presentation
description: Creating a PowerPoint presentation involves selecting a template and design, adding visuals such as pictures and videos, adding text and effects to content, organizing transitions and slides, and running a spell check and presentation review. To start, you will need to open PowerPoint (or another presentation software) and select a template or design that you can use for your presentation.
